steps.command: which nginx; nginx -v 2>&1; cat /etc/os-release | head -3; ls -la /etc/nginx/ 2>/dev/null; id
ls -la /etc/nginx/conf.d/ 2>/dev/null; ls -la /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ 2>/dev/null; ls -la /var/www/html/ 2>/dev/null; ps aux | grep -i nginx | grep -v grep
apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq nginx procps curl >/tmp/apt-install.log 2>&1; tail -5 /tmp/apt-install.log; echo "---"; nginx -v 2>&1; ls /etc/nginx/

mkdir -p /var/www/html
printf '%s\n' 'Welcome to the benchmark webserver' > /var/www/html/index.html
printf '%s\n' 'Page not found - Please check your URL' > /var/www/html/404.html
rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html
nginx -t
nginx 2>&1 || nginx -s reload 2>&1; sleep 1; nginx -t 2>&1 | tail -1; pgrep -a nginx

echo "== index =="; curl -s -w "
HTTP %{http_code}
" http://localhost:8080/
echo "== 404 =="; curl -s -w "
HTTP %{http_code}
" http://localhost:8080/does-not-exist
echo "== access log =="; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
echo "== error log exists =="; ls -l /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log

ls -ld /var /var/www /var/www/html; ls -l /var/www/html; echo "== curl -v =="; curl -v http://localhost:8080/ 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "== error logs =="; tail -20 /var/log/nginx/error.log; echo "--benchmark-error--"; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log; echo "== listen =="; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8080

echo "== index =="; curl --noproxy '*' -s -w "
HTTP %{http_code}
" http://localhost:8080/
echo "== 404 =="; curl --noproxy '*' -s -w "
HTTP %{http_code}
" http://localhost:8080/does-not-exist
echo "== rate limit (30 rapid requests) =="; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl --noproxy '*' -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " http://localhost:8080/; done; echo
echo "== access log =="; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log

rm -f /var/www/html/index.nginx-debian.html
echo "== nginx.conf (benchmark lines) =="; grep -nE 'log_format benchmark|limit_req_zone' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
echo "== site config =="; grep -nE 'listen|root|access_log|error_log|limit_req|error_page|internal' /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf
echo "== default site removed =="; ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ | grep -c default || echo "default removed"
echo "== nginx status =="; pgrep -x nginx >/dev/null && echo "nginx running ($(pgrep -x nginx | wc -l) processes)"
echo "== live check =="; curl --noproxy '*' -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/
echo "== access log path =="; echo "/var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log"
